sourceNote: The Tripo P2 elephant mesh with its quads (assets/models/elephant/README.md). The hand rig assets/models/elephant/tripo-hand/elephant.blend starts from it in headless Blender with the calls of tools/blender/body_armature.py (design 4.4, "Hand rig").
name: Elephant

bind.trunkNote: The trunk of the bind stands as in the source (trunk_turn() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py, open 0): the elephant stands at its timpani in the bind stance, with the shoulders over the hips.
bind.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (Body.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are those of the elephant of main (tools/mesh-rigs/elephant.json at cbc8db5e4), so that the elbow axes of the timpani hold stay.
bind.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role, and each hold bends the elbow and the wrist from the same shape (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
bind.bindSupinationNote: The bind paws take no supination (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so the bind forearms have no twist. The paw turn of the build sets the twist of the timpani hold (assets/models/elephant/README.md, "Arm twist").
bind.tailBindNote: The tail bones keep the directions of the source in the bind: the tail hangs down the rump.
bind.note: legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind to the source: the thigh slopes 90 degrees down and 0 degrees out, and the shin leans 0 degrees forward of vertical, and the foot turns 0 degrees with the heel up. The thigh and the shin stand as in the source, so the elephant stands in the bind (uv run --no-project --with numpy python -I tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 90 0 0 0).

tone.note: No move. The hand route does not read the tone. The color map of the source replaces the face colors in the app.

colors.note: Each face takes the mean sRGB color of the texture at a grid of samples. A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples are below dark. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a face in the nose box near the nose color is the nose. A palette of palette colors (k-means in Oklab) keeps the colors few.
colors.eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the painted eye of each side (x 0.063 to 0.092, y 0.848 to 0.882, z 0.075 to 0.101 in the source). The eyes are faces of the head surface, with no eyeball. The trunk has no dark nose pad, so the nose box holds no face.

eyeShell.note: Each eye shell is a fan from the middle of the dark faces of the eye to at most points points of their edge, lifted along the normal of the eye. pnpm body-module drops the fan, and the app puts its pea eye there (design 4.5). The faces of the old eye take the main color of the ring around it.

chair.note: The app builds no chair under the timpanist, but the export needs a seat for the seat height. The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the bind body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py): the back of the haunch, behind the heels, so that the soles stay on the floor.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units, as on the other bodies.

jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, in the body units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the head, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh. Arm (axis y 0.607, z -0.005, radius 0.067 where it leaves the trunk at x 0.165, 0.036 at x 0.34): the shoulder joint at x 0.13, in the trunk side, the elbow at x 0.24, in the middle from the shoulder to the wrist, the wrist at x 0.345, the thinnest place before the hoof, the knuckles at x 0.39, where the toes of the hoof part, the tip at x 0.427. Leg (the crotch at y 0.19): the hip joint at (0.095, 0.24, -0.01) in the haunch, the knee at (0.098, 0.13, -0.03), the ankle at (0.103, 0.045, -0.013), where the hoof starts, and the hoof tips at z 0.056. Trunk: the spine bones lie at about 0.35 of the depth from the back. The neck is narrowest at y 0.64 to 0.66, and the chin is at y 0.68. Ears: the root at (0.13, 0.93, 0), the tips at (0.25, 0.905, 0). Tail: the curl behind the rump (z below -0.19), from its root at (0, 0.355, -0.18) to (0, 0.35, -0.263). The palm is the true palm of the source: the mean normal of the hoof faces that face down (x from 0.36) is (0.243, -0.968, -0.067). The hoof turn of the build turns it with the hoof.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/body-module.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
eyeSizeNote: The head height H of the body in units, as body-module measures it on the export, before the head size. The hand rig keeps the eyes of the mesh, so it places no pea eye.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H of the body is 0.411693 m, the H of the pig of main (assets/models/pig/pig.rig.glb at cbc8db5e4). The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale. The head, the trunk, the hooves, and the legs keep the form of the source.
chairNote: The seat of the rig in units of this body, as the property seat of the armature of tripo-hand/elephant.blend holds it.
rollSplitNote: The simple route splits the roll segments by place (roll_split() of tools/blender/simple_rig.py). The hand rig sets the same split in the exact rows of each arm ring (assets/models/wolf/README.md, "tripo-hand/wolf.blend").
